mechanisms: Recursive and compatibility decomposition, Hangul bounds/exclusions, mark category versus combining class and stable source-owner sequences.

contracts: The same marked/unmarked glyph owner is checked for peak-minus-one refusal, partial cancellation after storage exists, zero retained bytes and exact-peak retry.
